name: Weather_Prediction_Model
description: 🌤️ A beautifully designed, interactive machine learning web app that predicts the weather vibe! Built with Python, Scikit-Learn, and Streamlit featuring a sleek glassmorphism UI.

paragraphs: Have you ever looked at the temperature and wind speed and wondered, "Is it a 'read-a-book-by-the-window' kind of day, or a 'grab-sunglasses-and-go' kind of day?" I built this interactive web app to take the guesswork out of the forecast. Powered by a Machine Learning model, this app takes a few basic atmospheric details and predicts the exact weather vibe you can expect!
features: Sleek "Dark Glass" UI: A beautiful, translucent glassmorphism design that makes the text pop against a gorgeous sunset background.
Tactile Sliders: No more typing numbers! Just drag the sliders to adjust precipitation, wind, and temperatures.
A Brain Behind the Beauty: Uses a custom pre-trained Python Machine Learning model (wp.pkl) to calculate the outcome.
Dynamic Reactions: If it predicts snow, your screen will actually snow! ❄️ If it's sunny, expect some celebratory balloons. 🎈
